thread:
sasha: Heads up — small runtime kernel update touching router header handling. planning a quick canary in the next 10m. will need console flag coordination and an API fallback window.

matt: window length? any blocked consumers?

sasha: 30m quiet window, start 1768469200. canary schedule: 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100%. runtime pinned to runtime-k137 for the waves.

jun: console will be shipped with flag `hdr_migration_v2` OFF. i can flip after router is validated. will the API still accept v1?

sasha: yes — API will accept both header versions for 5 minutes post-100% as soft-fallback, then we'll cut v1 if green.

riley: added brief release note: "runtime: header path optimization (k137). router: tolerate new header shape. console: gated flag for header v2." https://go/release-notes/1768469 (internal)

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for 1768469200. Plan: canary(5%) -> monitor(10m) -> expand(25%) -> finalize. Auto-rollback tags attached.

ops-runner: Rollback triggers (summary): p95 latency +200ms, 5xx increase +0.5%, spike in 502/504 >0.2%, or console logs >1% header-parse-errors. If any trigger fires, rollback runtime+router.

claire: quick ask — test harness for console schema will run during canary? want to ensure malformed-header alerts are surfaced asap.

jun: yes, running schema checks in Canary stage, will post results to this thread.

matt: preflight checks for oncall: `kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n prod`, `kubectl get deploy router -o jsonpath='{.status}'`, and `curl -sS -D - https://api.internal/health | head`.

sasha: assigning flag flip to @jun at 25% success. riley to publish notes externally after full rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary launched at 1768469200 -> 5% traffic. monitoring hooks engaged.

ops-runner: 1768469800: after 10m at 5% — p95 +8ms, errors nominal. promoting to 25% now.

claire: console schema harness reports 0.12% header-parse warnings in canary logs (below threshold). details: svc-console/canary-logs link.

matt: good. advancing. :white_check_mark:

jun: flipping `hdr_migration_v2` in console now (staged flag set to 50% then 100 at 25% success). will report once fully toggled.

sasha: thanks — holding to confirm final metrics before 100%.

ops-runner: 1768469361: 25% stage stable for 10m. metrics healthy. no rollback signals. proceed to full rollout.

riley: I'll update the external release notes after final pass.

deploy-bot: Gradewave to 100% started. full rollout in progress.

matt: oncall — monitor `router.latency.p95`, `runtime.errors.5xx`, and console header warnings. call this thread for stop requests.

sasha: release owner signoff: standing by. ping if anything odd. :eyes:

ops-runner: @sasha noted — final check looks green. completing rollout.

riley: done — release notes pushed to customer doc.

jun: console flag now 100% and retired fallback after 5m. all clean.

sasha: great job everyone. closing the window. :tada:
